headings.styling: Tight tracking (tracking-tighter), never use Inter for headings.

colors.archetype_strategy: The Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Corporate Authority. Primary blue is strictly used for CTAs and critical accents. Dark (#0e1629) anchors the design. Light grey (#f5f6f8) is used for section banding and bento cards.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix of 'Crystal Glass' (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/40) for sticky navs and 'Tactile Neumorphism' (sharp 1px border, flat backgrounds) for service bento cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - expose the skeleton with subtle borders (border-border/40).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient shadows only (shadow-sm or shadow-lg on hover), avoiding deep muddy drop shadows.

grids.marketing_tetris: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Prioritize asymmetry. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero texts.
grids.dense_dashboard_style: For Job Listings and AI feature comparisons, use tight grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4.

layouts.hero: Split layout. Left: High-impact typography stating Recruitment & AI solutions. Right: Immersive React Three Fiber Canvas. Do NOT use generic centered hero.
layouts.services_80_20: Bento grid prioritizing IT Staffing (80% area) and AI Solutions (20% area visually distinctly highlighted).
layouts.industries: The Swiss Grid: Overlapping elements, stark typography.
layouts.locations: Single location (27 Caragh Green, Naas, Kildare, Ireland W91 DXA9) featured prominently, possibly with a dark-mode card.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for momentum.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all cards (slight lift -translate-y-1, border color darkens).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid children using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Ensure white text on #3c83f5 is accessible. Use text-shadow over any 3D or image backgrounds if text overlays them.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='job-apply-button').

media.image_constraints: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices. Use object-cover for bento box images.
media.3d_strategy: React Three Fiber in Hero. A rotating wireframe brain or an abstract geometric mesh representing data and talent matching.

implementation_steps: 2. Create a Canvas component in the Hero section (.js or .jsx file).
4. Render an Icosahedron or a point mesh (representing a data brain) with a wireframe material in the brand color #3c83f5.
5. Alternatively, use @splinetool/react-spline if you have a Spline URL, but R3F is preferred for native generation.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a B2B IT Recruitment & AI Solutions website for JM DATA TALENT.
Ensure all files created are .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx or .ts.
Structure it similarly to Test Triangle (Hero, Services, Industries, Case Studies, Testimonials, News, Locations).
The split is visually 80% Recruitment, 20% AI Solutions. Emphasize staffing heavily.
Must implement a fully functional form for 'Book a Demo' or 'Contact' with Shadcn Form/Input components.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for complex marketing layouts like bento grids, overlapping hero elements, do NOT rely strictly on Shadcn Cards for layout.
Include a React Three Fiber component in the Hero section representing an abstract AI/Data node system.
Create modals for Job Application and Book Demo using Shadcn Dialog.
DO NOT ASK QUESTIONS. Make decisions independently.
DO NOT use a transparent background in the sticky header. Ensure white/70 with backdrop-blur and a subtle border.
Ensure the location is correctly listed as: '27 Caragh Green, Naas, Kildare, Ireland W91 DXA9'.
Use the specific brand logo requirement: 'JM' in Black (large), 'DATA TALENT' in Primary Blue #3c83f5 (small).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emojis like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing image categories = use provided images, DO NOT use placeholder text.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
